title: Without Reports — Page Access the reports are not listed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Have a user for this test whose role does not have 'Reports — Page Access', signed in in a second browser window.
  • Keep the address of Sales by Tier, copied from the first window.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open the main menu as that user.
  2. Open the copied Sales by Tier address as that user.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu shows Work Orders and the other areas the role allows.
  • Reports and the two reports are not listed.

Step 2:

  • The page shows "Access restricted".
  • No report figures show.
